modelAnswer.text:
Locked in a Pharaoh's Tomb!

I'd been wanting to try an escape room for ages, so last Saturday my friends and I booked one in Szeged. The room looked like an ancient Egyptian tomb, and in the story we were archaeologists trapped inside by a curse, with sixty minutes to find the key.

The most challenging part was a code written in hieroglyphs. For fifteen minutes we got nowhere, and time was running out. In the end, we split up: two of us searched the walls for symbols while the others tried combinations, and we cracked it with four minutes to spare!

I'd definitely recommend it – it's a great way to test your teamwork. My top tips: share every clue out loud and don't be afraid to ask for a hint. Have you ever tried one? Let me know in the comments!

In the end, we split up: two of us searched the walls for symbols while the others tried combinations, and we cracked it with four minutes to spare!
My top tips: share every clue out loud and don't be afraid to ask for a hint.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a három szempont három bekezdésben jelenik meg – a szoba és a történet, a legnehezebb rész (a hieroglifás kód) és a csapat megoldása, végül az ajánlás két konkrét tippel.

Hangnem: baráti blogstílus összevont alakokkal, felkiáltással és az olvasókhoz intézett kérdéssel a végén (Have you ever tried one? Let me know in the comments!), ez pontosan illik egy szabadidős bloghoz.
Szövegalkotás: időrendi felépítés, a cím felkelti az érdeklődést, az időhatározók és kötőszavak (For fifteen minutes, In the end, while) vezetik az olvasót.

Szókincs és nyelvhelyesség: természetes kifejezések, pl. I'd been wanting to … for ages (past perfect continuous), time was running out, we cracked it with four minutes to spare – mindhármat érdemes megtanulni.
